title: Haze4K train-only pairing, scene grouping, and data-role audit
rationale: Audit only Haze4K train, never the official test split, before any local-error measurement or model work. The official ConvIR-B test metric has been reproduced previously, but no candidate, threshold, proxy, or module decision in this program may use test outcomes. This operation verifies loader-compatible pairing, canonical clear-scene grouping, image alignment, filename-token syntax without assigning physical semantics, and a deterministic 2,400/600 train/internal-development split. Passing authorizes only fixed-official-weight local-error measurement on the internal-development scenes.

scientific_contract.question: Can Haze4K train be completely and deterministically paired by the official loader precedence into 3,000 canonical clear-scene groups and partitioned into 2,400 training and 600 internal-development scenes without any Haze4K official-test access?

intervention.reference: the official-anchor Haze4K loader mapping from a hazy filename to an exact or first-token clear filename
intervention.matched_budget: the complete Haze4K train split, with every hazy and clear file decoded once and no model, checkpoint, test, or external dataset access
fixed_factors: image extensions bmp jpg jpeg png tif tiff
input directory precedence IN then haze then hazy with exactly one existing candidate required
label directory precedence GT then gt with exactly one existing candidate required
exact-name then first-token same-extension then first-token PNG label candidates
canonical clear-scene SHA-256 over width, height, and decoded RGB bytes
scene grouping before any split or uncertainty calculation
rank by SHA-256 of split salt and canonical scene digest
first 600 ranked scenes internal_development and remaining 2400 training
two finite numeric filename suffix tokens reported without physical interpretation

primary_estimand.metric: proportion of all Haze4K train hazy files for which official loader precedence selects a decodable clear target of identical dimensions
primary_estimand.aggregation: deterministic full-train census with variants nested inside canonical clear-scene groups

controls: exact expected 3,000 hazy and 3,000 clear file counts
explicit redundant-candidate, missing, orphan, decode-failure, and dimension-mismatch counts
canonical RGB duplicate-clear audit before scene counting
aggregate filename suffix-token syntax and numeric-range audit
asset path restricted to the train directory so test is not delivered
compact aggregate evidence only with no per-image or per-scene table

uncertainty.method: deterministic census integrity audit; no sampling interval is used and files or variants never increase the clear-scene sample size

gates.estimand: route asset resolves exactly to a directory named train with confirmation permissions disabled
exactly one supported input directory and one supported label directory exist directly under train
proportion of hazy files with a deterministic loader-selected clear target
proportion of hazy and clear files decoded to RGB without error
proportion of uniquely paired decodable images with identical dimensions
additional clear filenames sharing a canonical clear-scene digest
proportion of hazy stems containing one scene token and exactly two finite numeric suffix tokens
filename scene tokens mapped to more than one canonical clear-scene digest
deterministic canonical scene counts in training and internal_development

scientific_contract.competing_explanation: Loader-compatible names may hide duplicated clear content, aliases, crop or compression variants, or undocumented generation metadata. Numeric filename tokens alone cannot establish atmospheric-light or scattering-coefficient semantics, and spatial transmission variation caused by scene depth cannot be relabeled as spatially varying scattering parameters.
disabled_actions: Haze4K official-test file, target, prediction, or metric access
model construction, checkpoint loading, training, inference, or evaluation
module, proxy, action, loss, threshold, or checkpoint selection
NH-HAZE, SOTS, ITS, OTS, canary, confirmation, or locked-test access
assigning physical atmospheric-light or scattering semantics to filename tokens
calling depth-induced transmission variation spatially varying scattering parameters
treating files, crops, regions, or haze variants as independent observations

precision_contract.rationale: The route audits the complete 3,000-pair Haze4K train population and deterministically assigns every canonical clear scene; integrity gates use exact census counts.

precision.source_reference: Worst-case Bernoulli standard deviation 0.5 fixed analytically; the operation observes all 3,000 expected train clear scenes.
